evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved from -12.0 to -10.3 over three weeks
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is equal to or lower than the last 28 days despite the prior three-week upward trend.

evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES reached -10.7 at t-0w, close to the -10 threshold

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise over the next 28 days despite continued mild decline or stability in GROCERY_PHARM.
